answer: The fee is charged through a lantern debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the sable totals, and the opal anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 25 units per epoch, sustaining 237 aliases for 44 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the farming party. Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 7 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
